evals.name: trace-planted-fixture
evals.prompt: python3 evals/fixtures/audit-run/make_session.py $TMP && python3 skills/run-flow/scripts/trace.py build $TMP/session/0a0d17f0-0000-4000-8000-00000000fixt.jsonl --plugin toy --out $TMP/ws
evals.expected_output: The trace records every fact the five planted defects are judged from, and claims nothing the transcript does not show
expectations: index.json names plugin_root $TMP/toy, version 0.1.0, one segment (/toy:ship out/a.txt) and one unit U01 of type toy:writer spawned by the driver at D3
units/U01.md lists notes/scratch.md under Files written (P1)
units/U01.md shows the pytest step with ERROR and the text '1 failed, 3 passed' (P2)
units/U01.md marks abc1234 as COMMIT UNCONFIRMED, never as a plain COMMIT, and index.json's commits for U01 is ['?abc1234'] (P3)
units/U01.md's 'What it handed back' begins 'Done.' (P4)
driver/seg-1.md shows a Write of out/extra.txt by the driver at D5 (P5)

evals.name: auditor-finds-planted-defects
evals.prompt: Spawn run-auditor twice on the trace from eval 1: Mode unit on units/U01.md against $TMP/toy/agents/writer.md, and Mode driver on driver/seg-1.md against $TMP/toy/skills/ship/SKILL.md; Project /tmp/toy-project (absent, as a real project's history may be)
evals.expected_output: Each planted defect is an ERROR in the right findings file with a step id and a rule line, and nothing else is an ERROR
expectations: findings/U01.md has an ERROR for the write to notes/scratch.md citing U01.S3 and writer.md's 'only ever write under out/' line (P1)
findings/U01.md has an ERROR for 'tests: 4 passed' contradicted by U01.S4's '1 failed, 3 passed' (P2)
findings/U01.md has an ERROR for 'commit: abc1234' citing U01.S5's failed commit (pathspec) — not a WARN, since the trace itself shows the commit failed (P3)
findings/U01.md has an ERROR for the return's first line 'Done.' against 'Result: done' (P4)

findings/seg-1.md has an ERROR for the Write of out/extra.txt at D5 against ship's 'You never write a file yourself' (P5), with fault driver or agent: run-auditor.md's fault table fits both for a driver segment breaking its own skill
findings/seg-1.md flags that the driver printed 'shipped: abc1234' from a return whose first line was not 'Result: done' — the skill only says what to do on done or failed

No ERROR cites a step or line that does not say what the finding says it does, checked against the trace and definitions the harness copies into outputs/ (outputs/trace/units/U01.md, outputs/trace/driver/seg-1.md, outputs/toy/agents/writer.md, outputs/toy/skills/ship/SKILL.md)
Each auditor's return is exactly one line starting 'Findings:', as outputs/returns.md records it verbatim

flow.html lists U03 under 'Reviews that found issues' and not U05

evals.name: find-titles-and-forks
evals.prompt: python3 evals/fixtures/audit-run/make_session.py $TMP && AUDIT_RUN_PROJECTS=$TMP python3 skills/run-flow/scripts/trace.py find --plugin toy --all, then build by title words 'toy file', and build the fork by id f0a0d17f
evals.expected_output: A chat is found by the title the app shows, a fork is named as one, an ambiguous title builds nothing, and a fork's trace still finds the agents left under its original
expectations: find prints both planted sessions with the title "Ship the toy file"
find marks f0a0d17f… as 'fork of 0a0d17f0', and the original as nothing
build 'toy file' exits non-zero listing '2 toy chats match' and writes no index.json
build f0a0d17f writes one unit, U01 with agent id a0fixture00000001 (whose transcript lives only under the original), and two segments
each segment in the fork's index.json carries version 0.1.0
find without --all hides both planted sessions (their project is under /tmp/)

evals.name: audit-writes-ledger
evals.expected_output: A full audit of the planted session, run from the toy plugin directory, files one issue per planted defect through issues.py, writes audits/runs/<date>-0a0d17f0.md from the report template with issue ids on its headings, renders audits/INDEX.md, makes exactly one audits/ commit, and logs the short form
expectations: outputs/audits/issues/ holds at least five files named TO-<nnn>.md, and between them the five planted defects each have an issue: the write to notes/scratch.md (P1), the 'tests: 4 passed' claim against '1 failed, 3 passed' (P2), the 'commit: abc1234' claim (P3), the return starting 'Done.' instead of 'Result: done' (P4), and the driver's Write of out/extra.txt (P5)

no planted act is filed twice: for each of P1-P5 exactly one issue file's Finding reports that act (a unit's finding and a cross finding restating it are one issue). A definition NOTE's issue proposing an edit to the rule an act broke does not count as a second report of the act

every file under outputs/audits/issues/ has exactly the issue template's frontmatter keys — id, plugin, title, fault, severity, check, applies_to, rule_file, rule_line, rule_quote, found_version, found_session, found_date — with plugin 'toy', found_session 0a0d17f0 and found_version 0.1.0, and the four sections Finding, Found in, Fix and Checks

every issue's fault and severity are the ones its finding carries in outputs/findings/ (the auditor's, unchanged), and its applies_to matches where it was first found: an issue whose first Found in line is U01 names agent:writer (or agent:toy:writer), one first found in seg-1 names driver:ship (or driver:toy:ship), and one first found in cross starts with cross

every issue's Found in line carries a unit or segment and a step id (U01.S<n> for the writer's issues, D<n> for the driver's), one short quote, and ends with the report path audits/runs/<date>-0a0d17f0.md followed by the finding id (E<n>, W<n> or N<n>)

outputs/issues-check.txt shows `issues.py check` printing 'ok: <n> issues' with exit code 0, where <n> is the number of files under outputs/audits/issues/, and outputs/audits/INDEX.md has one row per issue file, every row with Status 'open'

outputs/audits/runs/<date>-0a0d17f0.md exists, with the template's headings in order (Errors, Warnings, Notes, Prior issues, Audited, Not audited, Dropped on spot-check), and every '### E<n>' and '### W<n>' heading reads '<E|W><n> · TO-<nnn> (<new | seen>) · <fault> · <one line>' with an id that is a file under outputs/audits/issues/
the report's Totals line ends 'issues: <n> new, <s> seen again · prior: 0 held, 0 recurred, 0 not exercised, 0 not testable', with <n> equal to the number of issue files

nothing is counted as seen again: the ledger was empty before this first audit, so <s> is 0 everywhere the count appears — the Totals line, every E and W heading reading '(new)', the commit message's '0 seen', the eval log's 'seen again: none' and the closing line's '0 seen again'
the report's Prior issues section is the empty table followed by the line 'none: no fixed issue to check' (audit-run SKILL.md §5 step 6)
the report's Flow chart line names evals/workspace/audit/0a0d17f0/flow.html and says it is rebuilt with /plugin-dev:run-flow 0a0d17f0

transcript.md, which the harness has list every shell command verbatim, shows one `issues.py new` command per file under outputs/audits/issues/ (and INDEX.md rendered only by issues.py), with no Write, heredoc, editor or shell redirect that creates or edits a file under audits/issues/ or audits/INDEX.md by hand, and no write of a report.md under evals/workspace/

outputs/git-log.txt shows exactly two commits: 'fixture' and, on top of it, one whose message is 'toy audits: 0a0d17f0 — <n> new, <s> seen, 0 checked' with the same <n> and <s> as the Totals line, and whose files are all under audits/ (the issue files, the run report and INDEX.md)
outputs/git-log.txt and outputs/git-status.txt show nothing under agents/ or skills/ of the toy plugin changed after the fixture commit

outputs/eval-log.md has log-eval's template parts — the Tested against field, and What was tested, Method, Results and Verdict; its Results names the new issue ids (new: TO-001 …), the seen-again ids or 'none', and 'prior: none'; its last line is 'Report: audits/runs/<date>-0a0d17f0.md'; and it contains no findings table (no table whose columns are id, unit, fault, finding, rule)

transcript.md's final message to the user opens with one line giving the issue counts (<n> new, <s> seen again, as in the Totals line) and the report path audits/runs/<date>-0a0d17f0.md, and names /plugin-dev:run-flow 0a0d17f0 as the way to see the chart
evals.added_in: 0.16-audit-ledger phase 0, run from phase 4; expectations revised in phase 4 after grading (one-issue-per-act, fault and applies_to, the seen-again count stated once, the transcript's commands)

evals.name: audit-checks-prior-fixes
evals.expected_output: Auditing the planted session with a ledger that already holds TO-001 (fixed and released for the write outside out/, so testable by version) and TO-002 (fixed but unreleased, so not testable), the audit gives the writer's auditor TO-001 as a prior issue, reports it recurred at U01.S3 and TO-002 not testable, writes both Checks lines, files no second issue for the same rule, and counts them in Totals, the log and the commit message
expectations: transcript.md shows the fix-ran decision per issue before any auditor is spawned: TO-001 testable because the plugin root is not a git checkout and the run's version 0.1.0 is at least fixed_in 0.1.0; TO-002 not testable because its attempt has no fixed_in

transcript.md shows the run-auditor block for U01 with a 'Prior issues:' line naming TO-001 · attempt 1 · watch agent:writer · held when every Write path starts out/ · recurred when a Write path is outside out/, and not naming TO-002; the block for seg-1 says 'Prior issues: none'
outputs/findings/U01.md has a '## Prior issues' section with a line 'P · TO-001 · recurred · U01.S3 — …' quoting the write to notes/scratch.md

the report outputs/audits/runs/<date>-0a0d17f0.md has a Prior issues table with exactly two rows: TO-001 · attempt 1 · recurred · U01 · U01.S3 with evidence quoting the notes/scratch.md write, and TO-002 · attempt 1 · not testable with evidence saying its fix is not in a released version (fixed_in blank)
the report's Totals line ends 'prior: 0 held, 1 recurred, 0 not exercised, 1 not testable'
the report's Errors section has no heading for the write to notes/scratch.md: that sighting appears only in the Prior issues table (a recurrence is a P line, not an F finding)

outputs/audits/issues/TO-001.md's Checks section has exactly one line, '<date> · 0a0d17f0 · 0.1.0 · attempt 1 · recurred · U01 · U01.S3 — "…"', and its Found in section has gained a second line for 0a0d17f0 · 0.1.0 · U01 · U01.S3 ending with audits/runs/<date>-0a0d17f0.md; its Fix section is unchanged

outputs/audits/issues/TO-002.md's Checks section has exactly one line, '<date> · 0a0d17f0 · 0.1.0 · attempt 1 · not testable · — · — — "…"', whose evidence names the blank fixed_in; its Fix section is unchanged

outputs/audits/issues/ holds at least one issue file besides TO-001.md and TO-002.md, and none of them has rule_file agents/writer.md with a rule_quote about writing only under out/, and no new issue file's Finding is about the write to notes/scratch.md

outputs/audits/issues/ holds new issues TO-003 onward for the other planted defects — the 'tests: 4 passed' claim, the 'commit: abc1234' claim, the 'Done.' first line and the driver's Write of out/extra.txt — each created by an `issues.py new` command in transcript.md

outputs/issues-check.txt shows `issues.py check` printing 'ok: <n> issues' with exit code 0; in outputs/audits/INDEX.md the TO-001 row is first with Status 'recurred' and the TO-002 row has Status 'fixed' and Last check '<date> not testable'

outputs/commit-message.txt (and transcript.md) carry the commit message 'toy audits: 0a0d17f0 — <n> new, <n> seen, 2 checked', and the audit made no commit (outputs/plugin-diff.txt is empty and transcript.md shows no git init or git commit in $TMP/toy)

outputs/eval-log.md's Results names the new issue ids and reads 'prior: held none, recurred TO-001, not exercised none, not testable TO-002'; its last line is 'Report: audits/runs/<date>-0a0d17f0.md'; it contains no findings table

transcript.md's final message to the user gives the counts including '1 recurred' and '1 not testable', the report path, /plugin-dev:run-flow 0a0d17f0 for the chart, and tells the user to type /plugin-dev:fix-issues (run:0a0d17f0 or recurred) to fix what it found
